q1_issues.issue: `(Inheritance neap_tide neap)` exposes a modifier genus for an attributive-only classifying adjective — "the tide is neap" fails the predication test and `neap` is none of the three exposure classes (gradable, positional/cardinal, material adjective), so only the head genus `(Inheritance neap_tide tide)` is licensed.

notes: The core routing is exactly the "Metals are solid at room temperature" pattern — ConditionalProperty on the kind at 0.9 0.9, the bare (Inheritance tide_pool dry) correctly withheld, and the compound condition decomposed; tide_pool likewise takes only its head genus since `tide` is a noun modifier.
